movie.title: Other Mommy
movie.overview: A young girl, Bela, forms a relationship with a sinister entity in her home who looks uncannily like her own mother.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: A young girl and her family face a terrifying ordeal as a sinister supernatural entity attempts to manipulate her into granting it permission to possess her.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: After moving into a new home, a young girl and her family become the targets of a relentless, malevolent force. The sinister entity seeks to inhabit the girl's body, but it cannot do so without her consent. As eerie occurrences escalate into psychological horror, the entity employs insidious tactics to persuade her to let it inside. The family must uncover the creature's true intentions before the child succumbs to its dark influence.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: In this chilling horror-drama, a young girl's life is upended when her family begins experiencing terrifying paranormal activity within their home. The haunting centers on a sinister entity that fixates entirely on the young girl, harboring the malevolent goal of taking residence inside her body. Unlike typical physical threats, this ancient spirit operates under a dark rule: it must first persuade the innocent child to willingly grant it entry. As the entity begins impersonating familiar figures and invading her dreams, the family struggles to understand the psychological strain affecting their daughter. Eerie manifestations and escalating domestic tension strain the family's bonds, isolating them further from help. The mother desperately tries to protect her child from the growing darkness, while the entity's manipulative tactics become increasingly aggressive and deceptive. With every passing night, the boundary between the girl's reality and the entity's illusions grows thinner. Ultimately, the family must race against time to break the spirit's psychological grip and prevent the irreversible loss of their daughter's soul.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: A blend of psychological drama and supernatural horror, 'Other Mommy' follows a vulnerable young girl and her family as their domestic haven turns into a battleground against a malignant spirit. The haunting centers on a dark, manipulative entity determined to possess the child. However, bound by sinister rules, the creature cannot force its way in; it must first trick or persuade the girl into letting it cross the threshold of her mind and body. As mysterious events and eerie atmospheric shifts destabilize the household, the family must navigate horror both external and emotional to protect their daughter from an unfathomable evil.

story_structure.climax: The entity makes its definitive, terrifying push to take up residence inside the girl, forcing a high-stakes confrontation where she must resist its final persuasion.
story_structure.conflict: A sinister, manipulative entity begins haunting the home and targets the girl, attempting to persuade her to willingly grant it entry into her life and body.
story_structure.resolution: The immediate threat of the entity is addressed, leaving the girl and her family to pick up the pieces and face the lingering emotional or psychological aftermath of the haunting.
story_structure.introduction: A young girl lives with her family in their home, establishing a normal baseline of family life and domestic routine.
story_structure.risingAction: The entity intensifies its haunting and psychological manipulation, escalating the tension as the family remains largely unaware while the pressure on the girl builds.

characters.name: Bela
characters.description: The 8-year-old girl who serves as the central protagonist. She faces the terrifying task of resisting a malevolent supernatural entity that stalks her and asks to enter her heart.

characters.name: Other Mommy
characters.description: A sinister, shapeshifting paranormal entity that emerges from the closet. It assumes the form of Bela's mother to trick, manipulate, and ultimately possess the young girl.

characters.name: Ursula
characters.description: Bela's protective but deeply stressed mother. She tries desperately to protect her daughter from the entity while navigating her own marital problems.

characters.name: Russ
characters.description: Bela's father and Ursula's husband. He anchors the family unit within their increasingly tense and dysfunctional domestic setting.

characters.name: Grandma Ruth
characters.description: Bela's grandmother, who offers additional family support as the household descends into supernatural terror.
